scheme.title: HydroATLAS attributes
scheme.description: The BasinATLAS v1.0 attribute set, parsed from the official BasinATLAS_Catalog_v10.pdf. Each variable keeps its source dataset, citation, licence, units and native resolution so any value shown in the portal can be traced to the study it came from. Column names are decoded against the catalogue's own suffix syntax.
scheme.reference: Linke, S., Lehner, B., Ouellet Dallaire, C. et al. (2019). Global hydro-environmental sub-basin and river reach characteristics at high spatial resolution. Scientific Data 6, 283. doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0300-6

dataset.label: BasinATLAS v1.0 (global source)
dataset.description: Twelve nested levels of HydroBASINS polygons carrying 296 hydro-environmental attributes each. Referenced in place at 6.0 GB.

boundTo.reachJoin: HydroRIVERS reaches carry HYBAS_L12, so every reach inherits the attributes of the basin it runs through
